cards.card_text: Next, Jesus says they've heard it was said, “Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.” Sounds fair, but hold on, friend.
cards.verse_text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’

cards.card_text: They've heard “Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.” What does Jesus say about an evil person?
cards.verse_text: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
